summary: Do not report intentional mission waits as unexplained stalls

schema.detail: No database, claim, index or wire change.

compatibility.detail: Named and default stall reporting share intentional-wait classification with waiting-on. A run is suppressed only when every unfinished step positively waits on a known false predicate, an unanswered human gate, a native person ask, a blocker, a retry backoff or a live holder's declared wait. Predicate inspection reuses at most four fresh warm actual-cache observations of the pinned definition. Unknown evidence and mixed runs keep reporting; child-run holds remain conservative. Terminal notices, message identity, idempotency, ask delivery cadence and client-v0 are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores earlier stall behavior without changing stored state.
